name: arc-tip
description: ArcTip: Native USDC Tipping & Payment Links on Circle Arc Layer 1. Built for Arc Microgrants on DoraHacks.

paragraphs: Built for the Arc Microgrants | Circle on DoraHacks. Live dApp: Live on Circle's Arc Layer 1 Mainnet (Chain ID 5042).
ArcTip is a non-custodial tipping jar and personal payment link protocol designed specifically for Arc Layer 1 — Circle's stablecoin-native EVM blockchain where the native gas token is USDC.
Anyone (open source maintainers, Web3 creators, freelancers, hackathon builders) can:
features: Generate a personal tip link (arc-tip.vercel.app/tip/0xYourAddress) or display an interactive QR code.
Receive non-custodial native USDC tips directly to their wallet.
Attach on-chain memos recorded permanently on Arc Layer 1 via the ArcTipJar contract.
Enjoy zero token approvals: 1-click payment using msg.value directly in USDC with sub-cent gas and sub-second settlement.
Senders must hold volatile gas tokens ($ETH, $MATIC) just to pay network fees.
